gallery.overview: Browse examples of items, and click/tap to add them to a toolbar.
gallery.pluginNote: Some items require plugins for more sophisticated behavior.

clipboard.name: Clipboard
clipboard.description: Items that use the clipboard. Learn how to add these to Obsidian on the [Additional Gallery items](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Additional-Gallery-items) page.

daily-notes.name: Daily Notes
daily-notes.description: Quickly navigate between daily notes. Requires the _Daily Notes_ core plugin.

editing.name: Editing
editing.description: Adjust the order and arrangement of content.

editor-navigation.name: Editor Navigation
editor-navigation.description: Get around the text editor faster.

focus.name: Focus
focus.description: Remove Obsidian's UI and focus on your writing.

folding.name: Folding
folding.description: Collapse and expand sections of your note for easier navigation.

lists-indentation.name: Lists & Indentation
lists-indentation.description: Organize items into lists and adjust structure.

insertions.name: Insertions
insertions.description: Add various types of content like links or media.

mobile-navigation.name: Mobile Navigation
mobile-navigation.description: Helpful for navigating within the app and around the editor on mobile.

new-tab-view.name: New Tab View
new-tab-view.description: Replace the new tab view with a toolbar. [Learn more](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/New-tab-view)

note-toolbar.name: Note Toolbar
note-toolbar.description: Get access to Note Toolbar settings and tools quickly.

obsidian-support.name: Obsidian Support
obsidian-support.description: Get help from Obsidian community resources.

search.name: Search
search.description: Search in notes and across your vault.

vault-files.name: Vault Files
vault-files.description: Items that require access to vault files. Learn how to add these to Obsidian on the [Additional Gallery items](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Additional-Gallery-items) page.

workspaces.name: Workspaces
workspaces.description: Switch between workspaces. Requires the _Workspaces_ core plugin.

periodic-notes.name: Periodic Notes
periodic-notes.description: Navigate weekly, monthly, and yearly notes. Requires the [Periodic Notes](obsidian://show-plugin?id=periodic-notes) plugin.

templater.name: Templater
templater.description: Insert or create notes from templates. Requires the [Templater](obsidian://show-plugin?id=templater-obsidian) plugin. See the user guide for even [more ways to use Templater](https://github.com/chrisgurney/obsidian-note-toolbar/wiki/Templater).

plugins.name: Plugins
plugins.description: Do even more with other Obsidian plugins.

add-cursor-above.description: Add another cursor above the current cursor.

add-cursor-below.description: Add another cursor below the current cursor.

copy.description: Copies the selected text to the clipboard.

copy-block-link.description: Copies a link to the current block to the clipboard.

copy-note-content.description: Copy body of the note to the clipboard, ignoring frontmatter.

copy-obsidian-url.description: Copy the Obsidian URL for the current note to the clipboard.

cut.description: Cuts the selected text to the clipboard.

cycle-list-checklist.description: Changes to bullet, checkbox, or unchecked.

cycle-themes.description: Cycles between installed themes, including the default.

daily-notes-prev.description: Go to the previous daily note.

daily-notes-next.description: Go to the next daily note.

editor-toggle-preview.description: Change between the editor's Preview and Reading modes.

editor-toggle-source.description: Turn Source mode on and off.

file-append.description: Appends the prompted text to a file you specify.

file-in-explorer.description: Reveal the active file in navigation.

file-in-system.description: Reveal the active file in the system's file explorer.

file-move.description: Move current file to a chosen folder.

file-new-tab.description: Opens the selected file in a new tab.

file-next.description: Open next file in the folder, sorted A-Z. Loops to the first file.

file-prev.description: Open previous file in the folder, sorted A-Z. Loops to the last file.

folder-search.description: Search in the current folder, or all files if currently in the root.

go-bottom.description: Moves the cursor to the bottom of the current note.

go-home.description: Go to your home note. (Enter your home note in the URL.)

go-top.description: Moves the cursor to the top of the current note.

go-up.description: Uses your note's "up" property to link to a parent note.

go-next-callout.description: Moves the cursor to the next callout in the note.

go-next-heading.description: Moves the cursor to the next heading in the note.

go-prev-heading.description: Moves the cursor to the previous heading in the note.

indent.description: Increases indentation on the current line.

insert-embed.description: Add an embedded file or note.

insert-horizontal-rule.description: Insert a horizontal rule to separate sections.

insert-tag.description: Insert a tag in the note.

load-workspace.description: Select and load a configured workspace.

note-toolbar-backup-data.description: Copy Note Toolbar's settings (data.json) file into the vault.

note-toolbar-export.description: Writes an export file containing all toolbars as callouts.

note-toolbar-quick-toolbars.description: Opens a window with access to all of your Note Toolbars.

note-toolbar-quick-tools.description: Opens a searchable window with access to all toolbar items.

note-toolbar-toggle-properties.description: Toggle the visibility of note properties.

note-toolbar-user-guide.description: Access the Note Toolbar User Guide for help and tips.

obsidian-help-site.description: Opens the official Obsidian Help site.

obsidian-sync-version-history.description: View the version history for the current file.

paste.description: Pastes the text from the clipboard.

periodic-notes-daily-next.description: Go to next daily note. (Must be in a daily note.)

periodic-notes-daily-prev.description: Go to previous daily note. (Must be in a daily note.)

periodic-notes-monthly-next.description: Open next monthly note. (Must be in a monthly note.)

periodic-notes-monthly-prev.description: Open previous monthly note. (Must be in a monthly note.)

periodic-notes-weekly-next.description: Next weekly note. (Must be in a weekly note.)

periodic-notes-weekly-prev.description: Opens previous weekly note. (Must be in a weekly note.)

periodic-notes-yearly-next.description: Opens next yearly note. (Must be in a yearly note.)

periodic-notes-yearly-prev.description: Previous yearly note. (Must be in a yearly note.)

pin.description: Pins or unpins the current note, preventing it from being replaced when opening new notes.

search-replace-open.description: Open the find/replace panel in the current note.

search-selection.description: Search the vault for the currently selected text.

set-workspace.description: Changes to a specific workspace you provide.

templater-new-note-from-template.description: Create a new note from a template you select.

remove-heading.description: Remove the heading from the current line.

system-snippets-open.description: Opens the vault's snippets folder in the system's file explorer.

system-vault-open.description: Opens the vault's folder in the system's file explorer.

theme-toggle-light-dark.description: Toggle between light and dark modes.

toggle-bullet-list.description: Apply or remove bullet list formatting.

toggle-checklist-status.description: Toggle the status of checklist items.

toggle-code.description: Apply or remove inline code formatting.

toggle-css-class.description: Adds or removes the provided class in the cssclasses property.

toggle-fold.description: Toggle folding on the current line.

toggle-inline-math.description: Apply or remove inline math formatting.

toggle-numbered-list.description: Apply or remove numbered list formatting.

toggle-heading.description: Toggle the heading level on the current line.

toggle-ui.description: Shows or hides Obsidian's status bar, note properties, sidebar, and view header.

toggle-status-bar.description: Shows or hides Obsidian's status bar.

toggle-vim-mode.description: Turns Vim mode on and off.

toggle-color-highlight.description: Apply or remove color text highlighting.

unindent.description: Decreases indentation on the current line.

vscode-open.description: Opens the current file in VS Code.
